blocks.text: Grade 4 高频词汇 701–725
pulley /'puli/ n. 滑车, 滑轮；[医] 滑车
So, since pyramids were created before there were cranes or bulldozers - or even wheels or pulleys - how did the ancient Egyptians move these heavy rocks without machines?
中文语境：那么，既然金字塔是在起重机或推土机--甚至轮子或滑轮出现之前就被创造出来的--古埃及人是如何在没有机器的情况下移动这些沉重的岩石的呢？
spade /speid/ n. 铲子, 锄, 铲刀, 黑桃；v.t. 以锄掘, 把...弄实抹平；v.i. 铲
First, the Egyptians used tools like hammers and spades to dig up the rocks from the quarry.
中文语境：首先，埃及人使用锤子和铲子等工具从采石场挖出岩石
absorb /əb'sɒːb/ v.t. 吸收, 使全神贯注, 同化, 买进, 理解, 承受, 忍受, 承担；[医] 吸收
As the water was absorbed, the wedges expanded, and the rocks would naturally break into more workable sizes.
中文语境：当水被吸收时，楔子膨胀，岩石自然会破碎成更适合使用的尺寸
savory /'seivəri/ adj. 风味极佳的, 可口的, 味香的；n. 开胃菜
Sometimes, pies can even be a main course when they're filled with meat or savory ingredients.
中文语境：有时，当馅饼里有肉或咸味配料时，馅饼甚至可以成为主菜
mathematics /.mæθə'mætiks/ n. 数学；[机] 数学
Pi is one of a kind in mathematics.
中文语境：Pi 是数学中的一种
imitate /'imiteit/ v.t. 模仿, 效法, 冒充, 仿造
Steph and his brother liked to run across to the main court to see a few plays, then they rushed back to the practice court to imitate what they saw.
中文语境：斯蒂芬和他的兄弟喜欢跑到主球场看几场比赛，然后他们冲回训练场模仿他们所看到的
fast /fɑːst/ adj. 快速的, 紧的；adv. 很快地, 紧紧地, 彻底地；n. 绝食, 斋戒；v.i. 绝食, 斋戒
He was fast, and he practiced and practiced until he became one of the fastest shooters.
中文语境：他速度很快，他不断练习，直到成为速度最快的射手之一
paleontology /.pæliɒn'tɒlədʒi/ n. 古生物学；[医] 古生物学
Later research (and more fossil finds) showed that Oviraptor was actually a devoted parent, according to the University of California Museum of Paleontology.
中文语境：根据加州大学古生物学博物馆的说法，后来的研究（以及更多的化石发现）表明偷蛋龙实际上是一位忠诚的父母
pheasant /'feznt/ n. 雉鸡, 野鸡, 雉科鸟
Though some were as small as modern-day pheasants or turkeys, others were huge.
中文语境：虽然有些像现代的野鸡或火鸡一样小，但有些却很大
paleontologist /.pæliɒn'tɒlədʒist/ n. 古生物学者
In the late 1970s, the famous paleontologist Jack Horner and his colleagues found evidence showing how devoted some dinosaurs were to their offspring.
中文语境：20世纪70年代末，著名古生物学家杰克·霍纳（Jack Horner）和他的同事发现了一些证据，表明一些恐龙对它们的后代有多么忠诚
juvenile /'dʒuːvinail/ n. 少年, 少年读物；adj. 少年的, 不成熟的, 适于少年的
They studied a place where fossils of a duck-billed dinosaur were found in all stages of development: eggs, hatchlings, juveniles, and adults.
中文语境：他们研究了一个地方，发现了鸭嘴恐龙各个发育阶段的化石：蛋、幼体、幼体和成体
development /di'veləpmənt/ n. 发展；[化] 展开
They studied a place where fossils of a duck-billed dinosaur were found in all stages of development: eggs, hatchlings, juveniles, and adults.
中文语境：他们研究了一个地方，发现了鸭嘴恐龙各个发育阶段的化石：蛋、幼体、幼体和成体
palette /'pælit/ n. 调色板, 颜料；[计] 调色板
The Egyptian word "Tutankhamun Artifact" by Robert Thiemann is for "makeup palette" derives 8 from their word licensed under CC0.
中文语境：Robert Thiemann 的埃及词"Tutankhamun Artifact"是"化妆调色板"的意思，源自他们在 CC0 下获得许可的词 8
celebrity /si'lebrti/ n. 名声, 名人
Actors, singers, and other celebrities of the time all ate there.
中文语境：当时的演员、歌手和其他名人都在那里用餐
dislocate /'disləukeit/ v.t. 脱臼, 弄乱
The king of the tyrant lizards would not be able to hold itself upright without dislocating its hips and maybe even breaking some tail bones.
中文语境：暴君蜥蜴之王如果不使臀部脱臼，甚至可能折断一些尾骨，就无法保持直立
plume /pluːm/ n. 羽毛, 羽毛装饰, 羽状的；v.t. 用羽毛装饰, 整理羽毛, 使成羽毛状
Farmers living nearby heard a rumbling sound, and suddenly a frothy plume of spray shot out of the water hundreds of feet into the air.
中文语境：住在附近的农民听到隆隆的声音，突然一股泡沫状的水花从水中喷射到数百英尺高的空中
circular /'səːkjulə/ adj. 圆形的, 循环的, 间接的；[医] 环状的, 循环的
Eighty million trees were instantly flattened in a circular pattern.
中文语境：八千万棵树瞬间被夷为圆形
atomic /ə'tɒmik/ adj. 原子的, 原子能的；[医] 原子的
A fireball lands in Russia, with the force of 185 atomic bombs.
中文语境：一颗火球落在俄罗斯，威力相当于185颗原子弹
instantly /'instəntli/ adv. 立即地, 即刻地
Eighty million trees were instantly flattened in a circular pattern.
中文语境：八千万棵树瞬间被夷为圆形
nominate /'nɒmineit/ v.t. 提名, 任命, 命名；[法] 提名...为候选人, 指定, 推荐
President Barack Obama nominated Brown Jackson to be a federal judge in Washington D.C.
中文语境：巴拉克·奥巴马总统提名布朗·杰克逊为华盛顿特区联邦法官
discourage /dis'kʌridʒ/ v.t. 使气馁, 阻碍

But President Obama's nomination wasn't enough for Brown Jackson to become a judge. The U.S. Senate also had to vote to confirm her. Unfortunately, the senate didn't vote. President Obama wasn't discouraged. He nominated her again in January, 2013. This time, the senate voted that Brown Jackson should be a judge.
中文语境：但奥巴马总统的提名不足以让布朗·杰克逊成为法官。美国参议院还必须投票确认她的任命。不幸的是，参议院没有投票。奥巴马总统并没有气馁。 2013年1月，他再次提名她。这一次，参议院投票决定布朗·杰克逊应该担任法官
clerk /kləːk/ n. 办事员, 职员, 文书；v.i. 当店员
She worked as a clerk, a person in charge of the records and reports, for three different judges after she finished law school.
中文语境：从法学院毕业后，她为三名不同的法官担任书记员，负责记录和报告
federal /'fedərəl/ adj. 联邦的, 联合的, 同盟的；[法] 联邦的, 联邦制的, 联盟的
President Barack Obama nominated Brown Jackson to be a federal judge in Washington D.C.
中文语境：巴拉克·奥巴马总统提名布朗·杰克逊为华盛顿特区联邦法官
paramedic /'pærəmedik/ n. 伞兵军医, 伞降急救人员
A species commonly known as paramedic ants will go on raids to capture prey to eat.
中文语境：一种通常被称为护理蚂蚁的物种会进行袭击以捕获猎物作为食物
chaos /'keiɒs/ n. 大混乱, 混沌；[化] 混沌; 浑沌
Behind the chaos is a careful organization of roles and responsibilities.
中文语境：混乱的背后是角色和职责的精心组织
